podcast.title: Film and TV Composer for Queer as Folk
podcast.body: Don Pyle composed music for various film and television projects, notably writing the theme song for the TV show "Queer as Folk." "Don Pyle wrote a bunch of music for film and TV. In fact, if you know the show Queer as Folk, he wrote the theme song."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Prominent Photographer of Early Toronto Punk
podcast.body: Beyond his musical endeavors, Pyle is recognized for his significant work in photography, particularly his extensive collection of photographs documenting the early punk scene in Toronto. "He's also very big to photography and is well known for his collection of shots from the early days of punk in Toronto."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
